## **Secure and scalable** data movement,   transformation, orchestration and observability

Shared security responsibility means you maintain control over your data, while we take care of the underlying

infrastructure and platform security.

### Pushdown Architecture

Data never leaves your cloud platform. Run as hosted SaaS, or as a hybrid deployment.

### End-to-End Encryption

All communications are encrypted end-to-end, including volume-level encryption for metadata stored in Matillion's control plane.

### Reliable & Highly Scalable

Ensure smooth data processing and minimize downtime. Access live and historical reporting to confirm Matillion’s [Services Status](https://status.matillion.com/) at any time.

## Governance, risk management & **compliance**

Taking every possible step to ensure the integrity of customer data means starting with our own operations. Our dedicated Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team plays a pivotal role in defining security policies, conducting risk assessments, and overseeing compliance efforts to safeguard sensitive information.

[View Matillion Certifications and Attestations](https://www.matillion.com/trust-center#certifications)

### SOC 1 Type II

This accreditation showcases Matillion's dedication to creating, implementing, and maintaining security policies and practices that align with AICPA principles.

![](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/icons/Group-5715.svg)

### SOC 2 Type II

Matillion undergoes annual external audits to monitor the design, implementation, and effectiveness of its controls in accordance with the AICPA’s criteria.

![](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/icons/Group-5716.svg)

### ISO 27001

Matillion has completed surveillance audits with no reported non-conformities, underscoring its commitment to information security management.

![](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/icons/Group-5717.svg)

### GDPR

Matillion complies with all obligations under the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and DPA2018.

![](https://www.matillion.com/uploads/icons/Group-5718.svg)

## Safeguarding data **at rest and in transit**

Matillion employs comprehensive encryption protocols to protect data both at rest and in transit, ensuring data confidentiality and integrity throughout our platform.

[Download documentation](https://www.matillion.com/trust-center?types%5B0%5D=1955139&page=1&sort=postDate%20DESC#documents)

![Data Rest](https://www.matillion.com/assets/img/Data-Rest-1.svg)![Data Rest](https://www.matillion.com/assets/img/Data-Rest-1-mobile.svg)

### Data at Rest

By default, Matillion enables encryption on all storage solutions, utilizing the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) with a 256-bit key length (AES-256) for strong and resilient data protection.

![Data Rest](https://www.matillion.com/assets/img/Data-Rest-2.svg)![Data Rest](https://www.matillion.com/assets/img/Data-Rest-2-mobile.svg)

### Data in Transit

The Data Productivity Cloud supports the latest Transport Layer Security (TLS) protocols, including TLS 1.2 and 1.3, providing strong encryption for data in transit.

## Responsible and **robust data**   **privacy** in the AI era

Matillion’s intelligent AI features, including Maia, are not trained using customer data. You have to opt-in to use any of our AI functions, so you’ll always be asked for consent, and you can disable the features at any time. When using AI within pipelines, all data is encrypted in transit.
